name: print-social-laptop-screen-tip-post-periwinkle
title: Tip post with laptop-screen title, white note card and greyscale hands
whatItIs: A 4:5 periwinkle post with a laptop whose screen is a blue panel holding beige label blocks for the headline 'TRICK №2', a two-line explanation, a white note card with an orange top edge and numbered badge, and greyscale cut-outs of a hand with a mug and a hand with a phone.
whatItMeans: Clear, friendly and study-like; the layout resembles a lesson slide.
techniques: Put the headline on a laptop screen as label blocks.
Use a white card with a coloured top edge as a note.
Use greyscale hand cut-outs to add human touch and contrast with colour.
Add fine grain to unify the elements.

vocabulary.definition: Words on separate rectangles like tape labels.
A white card with a colour edge highlighting a key point.
A black and white photo of hands or objects.
A small circle with a number.
